name: Heuristics Miner
author: Promenade Team
description: Flexible Heuristics Miner: discovers a causal net or converts its AND/XOR grouping to an accepting Petri net with silent routing transitions, tolerant of noisy/infrequent behavior that would throw off Alpha Miner's exact footprint relations.

dependencyThreshold.title: Dependency threshold
dependencyThreshold.description: How one-directional a→b must be, from 0 to just under 1, to count as a dependency.

minFrequency.title: Min. directly-follows frequency
minFrequency.description: Edges below this count never become a dependency, however one-directional.

relativeToBest.title: Keep graph connected, within
relativeToBest.description: An activity with no surviving edge keeps its single strongest candidate anyway, if it clears (threshold − this).

maxActivities.title: Activity limit
maxActivities.description: Keeps only the most frequent activities.
